title: Negated IfExists in a Deny matches missing keys
note: IAM-1301: an EXPLICIT SCP selection analyzes this as an SCP region GUARDRAIL. StringNotEqualsIfExists on aws:RequestedRegion in a Deny also denies requests that OMIT the key (negated ...IfExists in a Deny still denies when the key is absent), so global-service calls routed to us-east-1 can be denied. With no NotAction global-service carve-out this is a potentially over-broad regional Deny (hazard). Never interpreted as a grant inside or outside the regions; zero capability edges.
